mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies with a temperature of 64 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail. The moon phase is currently a New Moon.

City news features the Verona Police Citizen Academy, offering a free nine-week look into modern policing starting September 23, and construction alerts regarding the Military Ridge State Trail bridge which will be closed between Lincoln and South Franklin Street starting September 14.
There is plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and the Dane County Farmers Market this Saturday.
The police department released information regarding an investigation that began on Sunday, August 30, concerning a former school staff member.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store opens today at 10 AM and will remain open until 10 PM.
